page.layout: One printed page (627). At the top, eight lines of Syriac text running the full width of the text block. Below them, one paragraph of Latin in roman and italic type, full width. Catchword "Ar-" at the lower right. Signature "Rr 2" at the foot. No running head.

main_text.p: Nominatim vero, & peculiariter suscipiatis, & agnoscatis Iacobum Episcopum Hierusalem Apostolum, & Martyrem, Linum Roma-num, Anacletum Romanum, Clementem Romanum, Timotheum Ephesinum, Titum Cretensem, Ignatium Antiochenum, Polycarpum Smyrnensem, Dionysium Athenien-sem, Hypolitum Romanum, Petrum Alexandrinum, Gregorium Neocaesariensem; Athanasium Alexandrinum, Basilium Caesa-riensem, Gregorium Nazianzenum, Gregorium Nyssenum, Meletium Antiochenum; Dionysium Alexandrinum, Eustathium Antiochenum, Nectarium Constantinopolitanum, Ar-

page.notes: The eight Syriac lines at the head of the page are not legible to me from this scan, so each is marked as illegible with an estimated letter count. Latin text is transcribed from the printed page; long s has been normalised to s. Printed hyphens at line ends (Roma-, Athenien-, Caesa-) are kept. The catchword "Ar-" is the start of the next page. The running head is absent on this page.
